## Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy & Incontinence

### Physiotherapist: Squeezing Can Make Urinary Incontinence Worse
- **URL**: https://www.ptsakkinen.com/videos/Qh8uK23HSAQ
- **Category**: Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy & Incontinence
- **Direct Clinical Answer**: If you leak urine while running, jumping, or coughing, this video explains why simply squeezing harder (kegels) often isn't the fix. Urinary incontinence can stem from two completely opposite causes — a weak pelvic floor or an over-tight, over-tensed one. Featuring pelvic floor expert Sofia Lahtinen, including a home test to distinguish weakness from tightness.
- **Full Clinical Summary**: If you leak urine when running, jumping, or coughing, you have probably been given one piece of advice: squeeze your pelvic floor more. That classic exercise where you tighten your lower body as if stopping a flow of urine. But very often, that is precisely the wrong solution, and at worst, it makes the situation worse. Here is what few people know: there are two opposite causes for incontinence, and they require completely different treatment. I...
